my place of strength in Da Nang 🤍
May 2026 • Family
Roots Café is my seat of strength in Da Nang 🌱

It's one of the first vegetarian cafes I went to when I first moved to town, and it immediately became a favorite. Since then, I've been back there again and again — and every time I go home.

There are incredibly delicious smoothie bowls, but my special heart is behind Mezze Platter💒It's perfect: the most delicious falafel, the most delicate hummus, baked sweet potatoes – I'm ready to sing odes to this flavor combination. And the warm pita? Just space 😍 So full and delicious that I can safely not eat all day after one such meal.

Roots is not just about food. It's about the atmosphere. Spacious two-storey building, quiet, calm, pleasant interior. They often work here on laptops, read, relax. The cafe also has its own guesthouse, so you can stay overnight.

Separately, it is worth celebrating the serving of dishes - everything is beautiful, generous and with soul. And desserts, though raw, for the amateur - but there are many to choose from.

Whether you're vegan or vegetarian, or just want a delicious, healthy and beautiful meal, you care about Roots Café. This place is definitely worth every dong spent.

Recommended from the bottom of my heart🤍

Root Plant-Based Cafe: My Dannang Fave
Mar 2026 • Friends
Travel rule #1: I never leave a place without tasting the local coffee. Coffee = life. So when I spotted Root Plant-Based Café right near our hotel, I knew it was a must-visit.

The vibe? Super chill. The name already screams organic, and the space didn’t disappoint—two floors, with the second floor giving off co-working energy. Free WiFi, spacious tables, and a mix of aircon + open space made it perfect for both work and hangouts.

Now, the highlight: I went adventurous with their avocado coffee + avocado shiitake toast. The fresh avocado blend came with a black coffee shot I had to mix in—sounds quirky, but trust me, it slaps. My friend went for a cashew milk cappuccino, and she was all smiles. We loved it so much we came back with more friends.

Round two? Oats cappuccino + coconut coffee. Affordable, tasty, and honestly cheaper than Starbucks. Root Café is officially on my Danang recommendation list.

Next time, I’m eyeing their smoothies and botanical teas—because this place deserves repeat visits, especially with family.
